clarification.boundedSourceMeaning: The footnote distinguishes the table’s material-plane-form destruction case from an actual permanent kill. The listed XP figure is for destroying the material-plane form; if the creature is actually killed permanently, its listed XP is multiplied by ten.
clarification.wordingToAvoid: “Permanently killing the material-plane form” collapses the two source conditions and is ambiguous.
clarification.markerDistinction: A single star invokes the permanent-kill multiplier. The dragon double-star denotes variable XP and is not the same marker or rule.
clarification.effectOnFinding: Clarifies the wording only; the ten named starred row count and ×10 permanent-kill source claim remain unchanged.
